svg.aria-label: National AI exposure across 33 African countries. Mauritius is highest at 0.289 and Burundi lowest at 0.144, against an African average of 0.211 and an average of 0.259 across all 140 measured countries. The index is the employment-weighted average exposure of a country's occupational structure, not a share of jobs.
svg.text: Employment-weighted average exposure of each country's occupational structure (index, 0-1). Not a share of jobs.
Garg, Crosta and Baier (2026), The Jagged Global Economy, Table 4, uses ILO employment data.
Occupational exposure scores are from Gmyrek and others (2025); estimates are modelled, not observed.
Nigeria, South Africa, Morocco and Senegal are absent from the source's baseline sample, not low-exposure.
